title: Local triage verdict (v1)
description: The structured output every local-model triage run must produce (operator decision, 2026-08-03: free-form prose replies scored 5.9-6.8/10 on remediation-format fidelity — both engines invented .gitleaksignore syntax. A machine-readable verdict against a saved schema is enforced engine-side: ollama `format`, LM Studio `response_format.json_schema`). Consumed by admin/serve.mjs runLocalModel(), written beside the .md evidence as <check>-<engine>-<ts>.verdict.json.

verdict.description: The one-word answer an operator sorts by. all-false-positives ≠ clean: clean means nothing was flagged, all-false-positives means everything flagged was dismissed WITH reasons.

id.description: file:line, rule id, or package@version — whatever identifies the finding in ITS artifact

action.description: the concrete next step, when one exists — rotate X, add ignore with reason Y, upgrade to Z

caveats.description: What bounds this verdict: truncated artifact, redacted values, could not read source, model unsure. An empty array is the affirmative 'no caveats', distinct from absent.
